metadata.description: AI plugins — skills and MCP servers — for the Multi-Mission Algorithm and Analysis Platform (MAAP).

plugins.name: algorithm-to-ogc
plugins.description: Convert a science algorithm into an OGC Application Package (OGC API - Processes) compliant description. Use when packaging an algorithm for interoperable deployment across MAAP and other OGC-compliant platforms.

plugins.name: maap-platform
plugins.description: Query MAAP jobs, batches, costs, and workspace files from your AI agent. A Streamable-HTTP MCP server hosted by the MAAP Console, exposing 7 tools and secured with Keycloak OAuth.
